description:
Export authorizations as CSV or JSON. Supports date range and status filtering. Maximum 10,000 records. CSV comes back as `{ content_type, body, truncated }` with the file in `body`; a body over 100,000 characters is cut at the last full line (`truncated: true`, `total_chars`) — narrow `from`/`to` or `status` and export again for the rest.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.
name: export_authorizations
